description: Mobile Testbed: Dataset of railway bridges, embankments and railway network is a dataset listed in DesignSafe Data Depot (published projects), a research data repository for natural hazards engineering under the section "other", published or maintained by Jamie Padgett, Rice University (rice.edu). This dataset contains the inventory of bridges and embankments, as well as the network topology for the railway network within the Mobile and Baldwin counties, Alabama. This dataset is part of the Mobile Testbed within the NIST Center of Excellence for Risk-Based Community Resilience Planning. Coverage: as described in the project (site or event named in the description). DesignSafe files it as a "other" project with 1 top-level file. Its DOI is 10.17603/ds2-vvtn-1h54. Keywords: railway,  transportation, hurricanes, bridges, embankments. Published 2025-03-01. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is ODC-By-1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support structural performance, hazard exposure and resilience studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-designsafe-data-depot-repository.
